title: WorkspaceFilesResult
description:
`workspace.files` result: bounded read-only entries under one workspace root.

The host emits `{ "items": [...] }` (`list_workspace_files`); the field is named `items` to stay wire-compatible with the current desktop/web parsers.

items.description: Entries sorted by path (bounded by the host).

FileEntry.description:
One bounded entry of a read-only workspace file listing (`workspace.files`).

Mirrors the host emission `{ "path", "depth", "kind" }` in `apps/desktop/src/ipc.rs::list_workspace_files`; `badge` is optional UI metadata for inspectors (absent on the current wire).

badge.description: Optional inspector badge (empty/absent when the entry has none).

depth.description: Depth relative to the workspace root (`0` = direct child).

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root (forward slashes; depth-bounded).

FileKind.description: Kind of one workspace file-listing entry (`workspace.files`).
